name: Untermünkheim (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Untermünkheim (a yellow stag's head with a trident on blue).
history: The municipal arms were granted by the Landratsamt Schwäbisch Hall on 25 August 1980.

features.role: Untermünkheim arms — stag's head on blue
